title: chore(pm-dispatch): review-nit follow-ups, same-family edge cards and copy- or changeset-only touch-ups dispatch at medium; epic child cards join the xhigh list, which outranks them

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D6F6L9qfcDr9r4CeKyQ85uE)_

Fixes #32784

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`execution-duties.md` 〈派发〉的 effort 行由一行拆成两行:三类本该 M 的卡(评审 nit 跟进卡、同族合并的边角卡、纯文案或 changeset 小改)从 `high` 降到 `medium`;epic 子卡加入 `xhigh` 名单;`xhigh` 名单压过这三类。
- **为什么改**:维护者裁定 6830795926 「同意，立卡更新 skills」。
- **风险与回滚**:仅规则文本 +1 行,行数棘轮上限 189 → 190;回滚即 revert。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位复审后落地(Tier S)。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` 〈派发〉, the effort line (L127 on `origin/main`):

Before (one line, 120 B):

```
- S 机械 `medium`;M `high`(默认);L/XL/security/p1/契约复核/四轴分析/ADR `xhigh`;`max` 凭点名/常设令。
```

After (two lines, 115 B and 116 B):

```
- S 机械/评审 nit 跟进卡/同族合并的边角卡/纯文案或 changeset 小改 `medium`;M `high`(默认)。
- L/XL/security/p1/epic 子卡/契约复核/四轴分析/ADR `xhigh`,压过上行三类;`max` 凭点名/常设令。
```

- **`medium`, down from `high`:** the three kinds, in the ruled proposal's own words (「评审 nit 的跟进卡、同族合并的边角卡、纯文案或 changeset 的小改」, two `的` dropped for the byte cap).
- **`xhigh`:** unchanged members, plus **epic child cards** (`epic 子卡`, a child of an epic parent, `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈Epic 子树车道〉). 「红线复读」 is the existing `契约复核` entry (a review of record, a new-head re-read included), unchanged.
- **Precedence:** `压过上行三类` — a card that is both one of the three kinds and on the `xhigh` list dispatches at `xhigh` (e.g. a p1 nit follow-up).
- **Unchanged:** S mechanical `medium`; M `high` as the default; `max` only by a named word or a standing order; L126 (effort and the step-down reason written into the `Container & model:` line and the order, passed explicitly) — that line already makes the claim name which kind a `medium` rests on, so it is not edited.

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the `execution-duties.md` ceiling **189 → 190**, with its record comment.

## Why

Ruling record **6830795926** on #32784 (maintainer, 2026-11-12T17:17:18Z, verbatim and untranslated: 「同意，立卡更新 skills」), agreeing to the proposal whose two rule bullets the card quotes verbatim:

> - **不降**：专题卡、p1 卡、安全卡、红线复读，继续用 xhigh。
> - **可以降**：评审 nit 的跟进卡、同族合并的边角卡、纯文案或 changeset 的小改，从 high 降到 medium。

Provenance (triage 6831382603 asks the landing seat to quote it here): the maintainer's question 「待办任务很多，是否建议尝试降低任务的effort」 (2026-11-12T17:16:42Z) and the ruling above, in the maintainer's project chat, thread `cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuUZ9URKazdwZeWD8MWEd9Bn`, as recorded in 6830795926. The proposal's third bullet (seats, concurrency) is out of scope, as the card says.

## Line budget (measured)

- The old effort line was already 120 B against the 120-byte cap and the file 189/189 (headroom 0); the added content (three kinds, epic, precedence) is over 40 B, so the rule cannot fit one line. ⛔ No re-wrap of other lines.
- Paid by an **ordinary ceiling raise of +1** (189 → 190), ordered by ruling record **6830795926**, authorized under ruling record **6184799323** (letter B: a ruling of record that orders text into a ratcheted file raises that file's ceiling by the measured lines the text needs). Not a `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` destination. Headroom 0 after.

## Pointers checked (not edited)

`SKILL.md` (`Container & model:` claim template), `coordinator.md` 四 and `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 only say "effort by card difficulty" and repeat no list, so none contradicts the new text.
